email.subject: Moving your delivery from Tuesday to Thursday
email.body:
Hi Alex,

One of our trucks is in for repairs, so we need to move your pallet delivery from Tuesday to Thursday. Same 8 to 10 am window, same loading dock, and no change to the price.

Does Thursday still work on your end? If not, Friday morning is open too.

Thanks for bearing with us,
Jordan Wells
Wells Freight
